title: Title slide: God's Garden in Eden (4)
summary: Title slide for the study "God's Garden in Eden", numbered 4, laid over a video still of the presenter sitting on a sofa in front of a large world map.

pictures.description: A man (the presenter) with glasses and a goatee sits on a tan sofa raising one finger as he speaks, wearing a white Hard Rock Cafe t-shirt. Behind him a large wall map of the world shows Africa, Europe, Asia and the Americas; a red mug is partly visible at the lower left.
